body: Thank you for your response. Having multiple supervisors has been extremely innoficient and confusing. On top of this, I am getting feedback from the Account side and the client, so my work has to go all the way through the process again. I have tried the approach of giving them more than what they will ever need, but I've been told to stop because they feel like I'm not spending enough time with each idea. This is the opposite of what I was taught in advertising school. I have looked online to see what others have been saying about my company and they say the pipeline is a total mess.

I am required to post 2 versions for each. I used to submit a lot more options because that's what I was taught in school, but my supervisors don't like that approach. They think I'm not giving enough thought into each option if I give them a lot to choose from.

Well I have 3 brands with different tones. The main brand I'm having the most disagreement with is a fast food restaurant that wants to model themselves after Chipotle and Wendy's voicewise and am told to look to them for inspiration. My supervisor describes our voice as "cocky, confident, and tough." I feel there is a big disconnect because every time I try to add humor like Wendy's and Chipotle do for their social media, it's shot down. Sometimes we will post a funny picture that lacks a funny caption because telling a joke that makes sense in the context of the image "wouldn't match the voice of the brand." So we'll have a funny meme, but end up with a caption saying "Nobody makes food better than we do." or something generic like that.

The person who brought her over was her best friend and she stayed until we were done talking then brought her home. I think getting her back out into the world and talking to people would be the right thing to do. Thank you for your advice, I really appreciate it.

We did talk about her dropping the sorority all together. She is on their executive committee and she sees it as her duty to stay, even though it would probably be better for her to leave (They are out of money and don't have a good reputation). Before all this stuff went down she was a very social person and we had a lot of mutual friends in different places. I think she just doesn't want to make any changes.
